title: 领域已知答案门 / per-domain known-answer completion gate
owners: domain reviewer plus the independent benchmark custodian (roadmap §9 M4 row, §8 gate list)
finalCompletionEvidenceText: 每领域已知答案、负例、完整自动成果和更新实例 (roadmap §9:153)
whyM4: M4 is the batch that names the breadth domains, so the gate has to say what a domain row will be judged on before any of those rows can be claimed complete.

criteria.name: known answer from an independent path
criteria.predicate: For each domain row the manifest names an answer computed by a path other than the candidate under test, with the method and its version recorded.
criteria.recompute: diff the candidate result against the manifest answer within the rule's frozen tolerance; assert the manifest names the independent path.
criteria.stateToday: NOT-AVAILABLE-PENDING-USER for all eight M4 domains (no qualifying domain input exists in this workspace)

criteria.name: negative example
criteria.predicate: Each domain ships at least one input that must be refused before output, with the reason expected in advance.
criteria.recompute: assert the refusal happened before any artifact was written and that the reason names the missing precondition.
criteria.stateToday: defined per scenario as the invalid profile; not run

criteria.name: complete automatic result
criteria.predicate: The result is produced without a manual step; a development-time manual fix is never booked as an automatic success (inherited from Z12 wording).
criteria.recompute: walk the action log for manual interventions; assert none feeds the scored artifact.

criteria.name: updated instance
criteria.predicate: A changed input re-run keeps the design intent and publishes only the declared deltas.
criteria.recompute: diff the two runs on slots and figures; assert the delta set equals the declared one.

criteria.name: domain ledger separated from the tool ledger
criteria.predicate: A domain pass never increments a tool-availability account by itself, and a GP or bridge path used under a whitelist entry is booked as an algorithm use, not as a new tool (FINAL §2 five accounts).
criteria.recompute: assert the account written for a row is the one its rule declares.
criteria.stateToday: definition only; inherited from GBC-001 and RAS-003

domainReadiness.blockingPrecondition: a time-enabled series with a declared calendar and a known change or forecast answer
an elevation surface with published control heights and a declared vertical datum
a real point cloud per format with a reference ground set (no .las/.laz/.copc here)
multi-band imagery with published QA plus a reference mask, class legend or model register
observations plus a published design, method and fold geometry
a network dataset with impedance and direction (no solver entry in the frozen 53)
an interchange standard version and a modern container adapter (none in the accepted source)
an approved Open XML generator and a verified document channel

deferredScopeNote: Reviewer recruitment, blind ordering and the professional panel are execution-side activities of a later batch; this file freezes only what will be checked and how.
